tweet.text:
Lots of excitement about GPT-5 in Codex CLI via your ChatGPT plan. Some details:

1. Yes, if you sign in with ChatGPT, usage is included via your paid plan!

2. Still determining exact rate limits, but the goal is to be generous:
-- Pro users should basically not hit limits unless they're scripting or running many agents in parallel.
-- Plus & Team users should be able to log a handful of 1-2h coding sessions each week.
-- Ent coming soon.
-- Rate limits reset every 5h, and there's a weekly total limit too.
-- If you hit limits sooner than expected given the above, reach out to help us tune the limits.

3. Issues people are hitting:
-- People are consuming limits faster than expected. We've landed a mitigation so do try again.
-- If you're an existing Codex CLI user running into issues with your ChatGPT plan, you can reset with /logout.
-- Still sorting out compute for Europe. Hopefully you're sleeping, or you can VPN to USA. Should be fixed by the time you wake up.

4. DMs open for feedback
